import sympy as sp
th=sp.Rational(90,10)
assert sp.simplify(sp.tan(sp.rad(4*th))*sp.tan(sp.rad(6*th))-1)==0
r=sp.cot(sp.rad(5*th))
opts={'A':sp.sqrt(3),'B':-sp.sqrt(3),'C':-1,'D':1}
assert sp.simplify(r-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert sp.simplify(r-opts[k])!=0

from fractions import Fraction as F
r=1/(1/F(4,3)+1/F(2))*60
opts={'A':F(5,4)*60,'B':55,'C':48,'D':F(5,3)*60}
assert r==opts['C']
for k in 'ABD': assert r!=opts[k]

import sympy as sp
r=16; h=8
csa=sp.pi*r*sp.sqrt(r**2+h**2)
s5,s3=sp.sqrt(5),sp.sqrt(3)
opts={'A':164*s5*sp.pi,'B':162*s3*sp.pi,'C':132*s3*sp.pi,'D':128*s5*sp.pi}
assert sp.simplify(csa-opts['D'])==0
for k in 'ABC': assert sp.simplify(csa-opts[k])!=0
